name: Darío Vincelli
source:
Exhibiting sharp intuition, EPPA-98152 approaches everyone with a combative temperament. His true intentions are tightly guarded. He reveals little beyond what he chooses to show.

His judgements are swift and often defensive, shaped by suspicion as much as observation.

How far can you push before he lashes out?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700130/TELLURICENE/]Steam[/url]]
